selection.rationale: A normal interior MoE layer with a full indexer refresh, in the last complete 8,192-token chunk. Chosen by structure and existing raw-trace review, not by speed; this is one invocation, not a statistical average.
selection.grouping_note: This alternative partitions all41 existing family leaves once. Indexer refresh and Q/KV preparation share one group because the current RoPE family merges an indexer call and an attention call. Split only via the separately supplied event partition, never by duplicating a family node.
limitations: This index-refresh example does not represent index-reuse layers, the dense first layer, the padded final chunk, draft work or PP communication.
Layer ownership is reviewed source-order inference after runtime/forward correlation. Nsight warned that some records might be missing.
13 operator families have no reviewed work-to-event join. Their measured times remain visible; full-layer MFU and MBU remain unavailable.
Useful-byte MBU is an interface estimate, not measured DRAM traffic. Cache/on-chip reuse can make it exceed 100%; values are not clipped.
